title: Reading Drill — Measuring the Size of a Pottery Bowl
description: One short passage, five questions. Recommended time: 8 minutes.

passages.title: Measuring the Size of a Pottery Bowl
passages.body:
**A** A pottery class made bowls from the same clay and measured their widths before and after firing. Each bowl was marked at the widest point so a later reading would use the same position.

**B** Some bowls shrank more than others. The teacher checked whether walls of different thickness had dried evenly before the students put them into the kiln.

**C** The final display compared a fired bowl with a paper circle tracing its original outline. This made the amount of shrinkage visible even without a printed figure.
